title: lncRNA-aware single-cell re-analysis of the human Liver Cell Atlas: code and result tables
description: Analysis code, intermediate result tables, donor-level validation, independent-cohort replication, and the revision analyses for the manuscript "An lncRNA-aware single-cell framework with donor-level validation identifies reproducible MEG3 enrichment in human liver sinusoidal endothelial cells" (Hidenori Tani). Includes an lncRNA-aware single-cell feature-selection pipeline, a donor-level detection-rate validation framework, a replication of the MEG3-in-LSEC result in the independent MacParland et al. 2018 atlas, and the 2026-08 revision analyses: an audit of the marker-score lineage assignment against the source publication's annotation, the re-screen under both label sets, a fixed-pseudotime contamination test, a 20-root sensitivity sweep, abundance and dispersion measures, and a feature-selection benchmark. That audit withdraws three claims of the first submitted version (the three progression-coupled lncRNAs and the KCNQ1OT1 hepatocyte depletion); see the README. Primary data are public via GEO accessions GSE192742 (Guilliams et al. 2022) and GSE115469 (MacParland et al. 2018) and are not redistributed here.
